title: Grammy-Winning RnB Artist Elijah Blake and American Idol Winner Jordin Sparks Team Up for New Single 'Deux'
htmlContent:
Elijah Blake is a Grammy-winning RnB artist and songwriter from the United States. Born in 1990 in California, Blake's love for music began at a young age, and he started writing songs and producing music as a teenager. He is best known for his work as a songwriter for famous artists such as Usher, Rihanna, and Justin Bieber. Blake has also released several critically acclaimed albums, including "Shadows & Diamonds" and "Audiology."

Jordin Sparks is an American singer, songwriter, and actress who rose to fame after winning the sixth season of American Idol. Born in Arizona in 1989, Sparks has since released several successful albums and collaborated with numerous artists across different genres. Sparks is also known for acting, with roles in popular TV shows such as "The Suite Life on Deck" and "CSI: Crime Scene Investigation."

Together, Blake and Sparks bring their considerable talent and musical prowess to the single "Deux," a track that will surely be a hit with RnB and pop fans alike. With their powerful and soulful vocals, the two artists showcase their love for '90s-style duets and create a modern and timeless track. As they release new music, fans can look forward to more collaborations from these two musical powerhouses.
